secrets.name: APEX_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Long-lived admin bearer token checked on every /api/* request. Required at boot — the auth middleware throws at module load without it.

secrets.name: APEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Admin password for dashboard login (POST /api/auth/login exchanges it for the token). Not needed at boot but needed to use the dashboard.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key — powers all LLM calls for the 13-agent workforce. Not required at boot; agents fail gracefully without it.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY_2
secrets.description: Optional second OpenRouter key for redundancy.
